name: Facebook Job Factory V2.8.6.0 (Anti-Stuck & Auto-Resume)
architecture: single FastAPI + SQLite durable RUN workers + central Facebook + one Flow worker/queue + durable Flow outbox + persistent scene checkpoints
fixes: Windows Unicode hardening: all V2.8 child Python processes force PYTHONUTF8=1/PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and BROLL engine reconfigures stdout/stderr to UTF-8 errors=replace, preventing charmap/cp1252 log crashes.
Single-instance guard: if an older V2.8 is already serving port 3000, stop only the verified V2.8 supervisor/listener before starting the new build; unrelated apps are never killed
Job 1 preflight, ENV STATUS and BROLL child use the same direct resolve_env_snapshot source-of-truth; no os.getenv/get_env split-brain
BROLL subprocess explicitly overlays resolved PEXELS/PIXABAY/SERPER/9Router values even if inherited Windows env variables are blank/stale
Startup logs exact root/port/PID so multiple V2.8 processes are immediately visible
Unified secret resolver: process non-empty > V28_ENV_FILE > root .env > embedded module .env > read-only V2.4/V2.5/V2.6 sibling .env fallback for shared keys
Job 1 preflight and BROLL subprocess share the exact same resolved environment snapshot; no split-brain key detection
ENV_CHECK.bat reports configured/source/source_path without exposing secret values
START.bat opens a dedicated persistent cmd /k console on port 3000 so terminal output cannot disappear after process exit
Supervisor catches fatal exceptions outside the child loop and HALTs visibly until STOP.bat/Ctrl+C
Root .env loader lets non-empty process env win but replaces inherited EMPTY vars with valid .env values
Job 1 preflight reloads root .env and reports safe key source/configured diagnostics without exposing secrets
Supervisor mirrors its own lifecycle logs into data/server_console.log as well as server_crash.log
Crash-loop guard HALTS without exiting so terminal/log remains available until STOP.bat or Ctrl+C
ENV_CHECK.bat verifies 9Router/Pexels/Pixabay/Serper presence without printing secret values
Hard port isolation: V2.8 Flow worker can connect only ws://127.0.0.1:3000/ws/flow; no scan/migration/connect to 8786/8787/8897
Edge ownership documented as debug port 9224; V2.8 never scans/kills/connects Edge debug 9222/9223
FLOW_WORKER 14.7.0 manifest restricts localhost permissions/CSP to port 3000 and popup server URL is readonly
In-process Beauty/Parenting legacy AGENT_PORT resolves to V28_PORT=3000 under V28_ISOLATED_FLOW; standalone copies still retain their own legacy ports
Exact 9ROUTER_API_KEY and 9ROUTER_BASE_URL env names supported across celebrity/beauty/parenting
Facebook/Job1 generic LLM fallback disabled: GPT/Gemini requests require 9Router
FLOW_WORKER 14.6.9 migrates legacy Chrome storage serverUrl 8786/8897 to ws://127.0.0.1:3000/ws/flow so V2.8 cannot silently reconnect to V2.5 server
server refuses FLOW_WORKER <14.6.9 and worker HELLO/log includes buildId=2.8.5.3 for visible verification
per-engine dispatch is serialized in SQLite with waiting_engine; DB workers no longer park indefinitely on asyncio.Lock
in-memory engine lock is a fail-safe only and records owner run_id; lock release always wakes durable queue
stale active engine owners with heartbeat >90s are auto-interrupted so waiting_engine cannot stay blocked forever after a vanished task
START.bat always pauses after supervisor exits, so a double-click terminal cannot disappear without leaving visible status
run_server/server_console persistent logs retained; startup banner prints exact build and required FLOW_WORKER version
locale-aware Google Flow URL detection: /fx/vi/tools/flow/project/<id> and other locale routes stay in the existing project instead of being redirected to landing/create-project
Flow project recovery/navigation preserves the current locale prefix when returning to project root

fresh persona/reference upload no longer immediately re-uploads when Asset Picker indexing lags; waits exact mediaId, correlates only new filename IDs, reloads same project once, then emits FLOW_ASSET_INDEX_DELAY without duplicate upload
run_server.py direct invocation is supervised; silent child exit code 0 without STOP request is restarted instead of closing the terminal
persistent data/server_console.log mirrors stdout/stderr; data/server_crash.log remains for crashes
STOP.bat writes an explicit stop flag so supervisor can distinguish requested shutdown from silent exit
DB upgrade order fixed: add archived columns before creating indexes that reference them; preserves existing V2.8.x data
V2.8.4 audit30 fixes retained
healthy equal-version/same-extension Flow duplicates can no longer supersede the active socket
forced extension reconnect closes old socket and waits before opening replacement to eliminate same-worker websocket race
FLOW_WORKER 14.6.9 with 8s server ping + 20s extension heartbeat retained
server supervisor restarts child only on unexpected crash and writes data/server_crash.log
PID files allow STOP.bat to stop both supervisor and uvicorn child without accidental restart
run_server enables faulthandler and persists Python crash traceback
audited and fixed 30+ lifecycle/state/config/UI failure modes
durable SQLite RUN queue with race-safe claim/recovery/waiting_flow
per-engine serialization prevents legacy BROLL/parenting/beauty workdir collisions
Flow bridge heartbeat/stale protection; equal/older duplicates cannot replace healthy worker
FLOW_WORKER minimum 14.6.9 and duplicate 4009 stop-reconnect behavior
global image/video model, concurrency, duration/output settings actually reach extension; removed hard-coded 9/4 paths
durable SQLite Flow outbox recovers result/media messages across internal bridge reconnects
strict run/result identity checks prevent late Flow result finishing wrong run
Job 1 preflight validates ffmpeg/ffprobe, edge-tts, B-roll keys and celebrity source readiness
Job 1 subprocess errors surface root stderr/stdout instead of generic exit code 1
persona upload validation + clone isolation; parenting character/reference isolation per job instance
Facebook video preflight, permanent Graph error classification, page mapping integrity
strict API validation, scheduler isolation/timezone fixes, soft-delete history retention
frontend stale-response/toast/status fixes; startup waits for server ready
